meta.catalog_source: Yale Bright Star Catalogue 5th rev. (Hoffleit & Warren 1991), VizieR V/50
meta.rgb: gamma-encoded sRGB, max channel 1 (do not apply gamma again)
meta.teff_rule: Flower 1996 B-V->Teff (Torres 2010 coefficients); logg from luminosity class
meta.clamp_rule: Teff, logg clamped into the grid's filled nodes incl. Hermite stencil; grid_clamped=true
meta.zp_note: zp_photons_s_m2: photons/s/m^2 above the atmosphere from a mag-0 star through the curve (peak-normalised photon response, curve_components says what it includes)

field_luminosity_function.form: log10 N(<V) [stars/deg^2] = a + b*V + c*(1 - sin|gal_lat|)
field_luminosity_function.note: a_all_sky with c=0 gives the all-sky mean; a with c includes Galactic latitude
field_luminosity_function.source: line through BSC5 N(<6) and all-sky N(<15) ~ 700/deg^2 (Allen's Astrophysical Quantities)
